AFTER AN EXHAUSTIVE BATTLE, YOU DEFEATED THE BLACK LEGION AND CAPTURED BARON CZARNY.  YOU WATCH AS THE MAD DICTATOR IS SWIFTLY SILENCED... ONCE AND FOR ALL.

THE BATTLE OF KRAKOW WILL BE REMEMBERED AS THE FINAL BLOW THAT BROKE THE CHAINS OF TYRANNY AND TERROR THAT SCARRED THE FACE OF POLAND.  YOU HAVE WRITTEN THE FIRST PAGE IN POLAND'S NEW HISTORY, A HISTORY BORN IN FREEDOM AND LIBERATION.
YOU HAVE DEMONSTRATED COURAGE, PATIENCE, LEADERSHIP, PERSEVERANCE AND WILL, AND YOU'VE SOMEHOW WON A WAR THE WORLD LOST.  PERHAPS MAN CAN LEARN FROM HIS MISTAKES.  PERHAPS THE WAR IS FINALLY OVER.

AS YOU CONTEMPLATE MANKIND'S FUTURE, A FUTURE FULL OF FRESH OPPORTUNITIES AND NEW BEGINNINGS, A TROUBLING THOUGHT STIRS IN THE BACK OF YOUR MIND.  GENERAL ANDREKOV WAS NOT CAPTURED, AND HIS BODY WAS NEVER DISCOVERED IN THE SEA OF CORPSES THAT COVERED THE SURFACE OF KRAKOW LIKE A CARPET.  SOME SAY HE DISAPPEARED BEFORE THE BATTLE OF KRAKOW AND FLED TO WHAT'S LEFT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.  OTHERS SAY CZARNY PERSONALLY EXECUTED HIM WHEN HE CALLED FOR THE SURRENDER OF THE BLACK LEGION.  THE MOST FRIGHTENING THEORY IS THAT CZARNY WAS ONLY A PUPPET OF GENERAL ANDREKOV, WHO WAS THE TRUE SOURCE OF POLAND'S TERROR.  AS LONG AS THAT DISTURBING QUESTION REMAINS UNANSWERED AND THE GHOST OF GENERAL ANDREKOV CONTINUES TO HAUNT YOUR NIGHTMARES, YOU REALIZE THE WAR WILL NEVER BE OVER.  CAN MAN REALLY LEARN FROM HIS MISTAKES, OR IS HE TRAPPED IN A NEVER-ENDING CIRCLE WHERE HIS DESTRUCTIVE DESTINY IS, IN THE END, UNAVOIDABLE?

WITH %s ORCHESTRATED BY GENERAL ANDREKOV.  WE MUST ADD TERRITORIES TO OUR SIDE OR FACE LOSING EVERYTHING WE'VE WORKED FOR.  FOR EACH TERRITORY CZARNY CONQUERS, WE MUST GAIN TWO!
THINGS ARE A LITTLE SLOW RIGHT NOW.  WHY DON'T YOU SEARCH THE AREA FOR HIDDEN SUPPLIES, OR RETURN TO BASE TO REST UP.  WE'LL NEED YOU LATER.

WELL, WE'RE OFF TO A GOOD START.  THE HUMVEE WILL COME IN VERY HANDY.  BUT A HUMVEE ALONE CAN'T DEFEAT CZARNY'S BLACK LEGION FORCES.  IF WE'RE GOING TO WAGE WAR - A WAR WE CAN WIN - WE HAVE TO ACQUIRE POWERFUL TANKS AND NUMEROUS SUPPLIES. I'M AFRAID THIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.  WE HAVE A LONG, DIFFICULT ROAD TO TRAVEL IF WE'RE GOING TO LIBERATE POLAND.

THOUGH WE'RE MAKING PROGRESS, CZARNY SEEMS TO BE GROWING MORE POWERFUL.  HIS BLACK LEGION FORCES HAVE FOUND ABUNDANT SUPPLY DUMPS IN NORTHERN POLAND.  I MUST WARN YOUR PLATOON TO AVOID THE CITY CHECINY.  CZARNY IS BASED THERE AND HE HAS THE CITY FORTIFIED WITH IMPENETRABLE TROOP FORCE. DON'T GO WITHIN 12 KM OF CHECINY OR YOU'LL WIND UP DEAD, AND THE FATE OF POLAND WILL BE SEALED.

CZARNY'S FORCES ARE AWARE OF YOUR PRESENCE.  THE HEAT IN THE KITCHEN IS REALLY GOING TO SOAR NOW.  BE PREPARED FOR ATTACKS AT ALL TIMES.  MAKE SURE YOU HAVE A SKILLED FIGHTER WITH YOU WHENEVER YOU TRAVEL.  THE BEST WEAPONS TO USE IN THE FIELD ARE M60'S AND GRENADE LAUNCHERS.  MAYBE YOU WILL EVEN GET LUCKY AND RETRIEVE A M2HB.  THOSE MACHINEGUNS ARE DEADLY.  THEY WILL TEAR THROUGH ANYTHING!  BE ON YOUR TOES AND GOOD LUCK.

I HAVE SERIOUS DOUBTS ABOUT YOUR LEADERSHIP ABILITIES.  YOU'RE GETTING EATEN ALIVE.  THIS IS NOT SOME KIND OF GAME; THIS IS WAR - LIFE AND DEATH!  YOU HAVE A DIVERSE GROUP OF SOLDIERS IN YOUR PLATOON.  THINK BEFORE YOU JUST THROW THEM OUT THERE.  BE AWARE OF WHERE THEIR SKILLS CAN BE USED MOST EFFECTIVELY, ARM THEM CAREFULLY, AND USE STRATEGY WHEN YOU'RE FIGHTING.  NOW GET YOUR HEAD IN THE BALL GAME BEFORE YOU GET YOURSELF KILLED.  WE CAN'T LET POLAND FALL INTO CZARNY'S HANDS!

I HAVE VERY BAD NEWS.  YOU SEEM TO BE FARING WELL, BUT ONE OF OUR OTHER SQUADS WASN'T SO LUCKY.  CZARNY CAPTURED A GROUP OF SPECIAL FORCES SOLDIERS FROM THE BRAVO COMPANY.  INSTEAD OF INCARCERATING THEM AS PRISONERS OF WAR, HE USED THEM AS A PROPAGANDA TOOL TO MOTIVATE THE CITIZENS OF HIS TERRITORIES.  THIS IS AWFUL, SO BE PREPARED.  CZARNY HAD THE BRIGADE MARCHED INTO THE CENTER OF CHECINY, AND UNDER HIS COMMAND, THE MEMBERS OF BRAVO COMPANY WERE CASTRATED AND BURNED ALIVE AT THE STAKE.  NOW IF THAT DOESN'T MOTIVATE YOU TO STOP THIS MANIAC, I DON'T KNOW WHAT WILL!  AVENGE THE BRAVO COMPANY, AND FREE POLAND.

YOU'RE DOING A FINE JOB.  THOUGH YOU'VE STRUGGLED, YOU'VE PROVEN YOUR WORTH AND SENT A CLEAR MESSAGE TO CZARNY AND THE BLACK LEGION.  WORD ABOUT THE COURAGE AND STRENGTH OF YOUR PLATOON HAS REACHED THE BARON.  MY INTELLIGENCE SOURCES HAVE RECEIVED A MESSAGE FROM CZARNY.  HE SAID THAT IF YOU AND YOUR PLATOON DON'T SURRENDER, HE'LL GATHER EVERY CHILD IN THE CITY LOPUSZNO AND EXECUTE THEM.  I DON'T BELIEVE A WORD OF IT.  IT'S JUST A TRAP THAT HE'S SETTING FOR YOU.  HE HOPES YOU'LL MARCH THERE AT ONCE SO HE CAN AMBUSH YOU WITH OVERWHELMING FORCE.  AT THIS TIME, WE'RE NOT TAKING HIS THREAT SERIOUSLY.  EVEN CZARNY IS NOT EVIL ENOUGH TO MURDER CHILDREN.  LET'S JUST KEEP TO OUR PLAN.  WE'RE MAKING STEADY PROGRESS.

NOW CZARNY SEEMS TO BE VENTING HIS WRATH ON AMERICANS.  ANY AMERICAN THAT THE BLACK LEGION CAPTURES IS AUTOMATICALLY SENTENCED TO DEATH AND EXECUTED IN THE CHECINY TOWN SQUARE.  INTELLIGENCE SOURCES SAY THAT CZARNY BLAMES THE AMERICANS FOR THE PERMANENT DISFIGUREMENT OF HIS FACE.  THE EXTERMINATION OF THE AMERICANS IS DISHEARTENING NEWS, BUT WE CAN'T ABANDON OUR CURRENT PLANS.  THE AMERICANS ARE MARTYRS FOR OUR CAUSE.  THE ONLY WAY WE CAN END CZARNY'S RULE IS TO SLOWLY GNAW AWAY AT HIM.  IF YOU TRY TO RESCUE AMERICANS IN CHECINY, YOU'LL NEVER SURVIVE.  WE MUST CONCENTRATE ON OUR CURRENT PLAN OF ACTION, THOUGH ITS MADDENING TO SIMPLY TURN YOUR BACK ON SUCH TYRANNY.  STAY FOCUSED AND CZARNY WILL FALL; GET EMOTIONAL AND CARELESS AND YOU, AND POLAND, ARE DOOMED.

CZARNY'S BLACK LEGION, COMMANDED BY GENERAL ANDREKOV, IS STEADILY CONQUERING NORTHERN TERRITORIES.  FOR EACH CITY THAT'S OVERRUN, MORE AND MORE WEAPONS AND SUPPLIES ARE BEING STOCKPILED IN CZARNY'S ARSENAL.  IF WE'RE GOING TO CHALLENGE AND DEFEAT CZARNY, WE MUST BEGIN GAINING THE ALLEGIANCE OF THE CITIES THAT SEPARATE THE NORTHERN AND SOUTHERN TERRITORIES.  IF WE CAN GAIN THE ALLEGIANCE OF CRITICAL TERRITORIES THAT ARE NEUTRAL, WE COULD STRENGTHEN OUR OWN POWER BASE AND WEAKEN CZARNY'S GRIP ON POLAND.  WE'VE AMASSED VEHICLES AND SUPPLIES, NOW WE MUST FLY THE FLAG OF OPPOSITION IN NEUTRAL CITIES - PEACEFULLY!

CZARNY'S FORCES ARE WEAKENING.  AS WE ADD TERRITORIES AND INVADE FORMER CZARNY STRONGHOLDS, MY INTELLIGENCE SOURCES SAY CZARNY'S REGIME IS CRUMBLING.  GENERAL ANDREKOV HAS BEEN CALLED BACK TO CHECINY FOR EMERGENCY STRATEGY MEETINGS WITH BARON CZARNY.  WE HAVE THE BLACK LEGION ON THE ROPES.  IT'S TIME TO FINISH THEM OFF ONCE AND FOR ALL.  LET'S BEGIN TAKING BACK WHAT CZARNY STOLE - NORTHERN POLAND!

I HAVE HORRIBLE, SHOCKING NEWS TO REPORT, SO PLEASE BE PREPARED.  MY INTELLIGENCE SOURCES SAY THAT CZARNY AND GENERAL ANDREKOV CARRIED OUT THEIR THREAT TO EXTERMINATE ALL CHILDREN IN LOPUSZNO.  CZARNY RELEASED A VIDEO TAPE OF THE EXECUTIONS AS A FINAL DEMAND FOR OUR SURRENDER.  IT WAS ABSOLUTELY BRUTAL - ROW AFTER ROW OF POOR, TERRIFIED CHILDREN BEING SHOT AND CARRIED AWAY LIKE RAG DOLLS.  MANY OF CZARNY'S TROOPS WERE ABHORRED BY THE HIDEOUS EXECUTIONS AND HAVE DESERTED.  CZARNY AND GENERAL ANDREKOV HAVE CLEARLY GONE INSANE.  THEY'RE LIKE A PAIR OF RABID DOGS PINNED IN A CORNER.  WE MUST STOP THEM NOW BEFORE THEY CARRY OUT OTHER THREATS. THEY SAY THEY'LL BEGIN LEVELING CITIES UNLESS WE GIVE UP, BUT IT'S CLEAR THEY NO LONGER HAVE THE STRENGTH. THEY'RE FINISHED.  LET'S BURY THE BASTARDS!

I RECEIVED AN INTELLIGENCE REPORT THAT SAYS GENERAL ANDREKOV IS OUT OF THE PICTURE.  I'M NOT SURE WHAT HAPPENED, BUT APPARENTLY THERE'S BEEN SOME SORT OF FALLOUT BETWEEN CZARNY AND ANDREKOV.  WHETHER ANDREKOV IS DEAD OR ALIVE, OR WHETHER THIS IS JUST A PLOY TO THROW US OFF, IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME.  BUT IT IS CLEAR THAT OUR PROGRESS HAS RATTLED THEM.

I JUST RECEIVED A REPORT THAT I CAN'T BELIEVE.  CZARNY HAS AMASSED WHAT IS LEFT OF THE BLACK LEGION AND IS PREPARING TO LAUNCH A FINAL ATTACK ON KRAKOW!  IT'S EITHER AN ACT OF SUICIDE OR THE MOST BOLD MILITARY ACTION EVER TAKEN.  CZARNY MUST FEEL HE STILL HAS THE FIREPOWER TO DEFEAT YOU.  YOU MUST PROVE THAT HE'S WRONG.  THIS IS GOING TO BE THE MOST BRUTAL BATTLE OF ALL.
